# Generate: text and pictures made from what a viewer types

`window.mindblown` (here `mb`) can make new text and new pictures while the page
is open, from words the viewer types. The person who types pays for it from their
own allowance. The page owner never pays for a viewer's call.

## Use it for anything made from a viewer's words

When the person asked for a page that makes something from what a viewer types
-- a reading, a meaning, a charm, a creature, a picture -- call `mb.generate`
with the viewer's words.

**Never match typed words against a fixed set and call the result generated.**
A page that picks the nearest of twenty prepared answers is not what the person
asked for, and they see it at once.

## The calls

```js
const { text } = await mb.generate.text("What does a crystal ball show for 'a new job'?");
const { url, sha } = await mb.generate.image("a realistic morpho butterfly, teal and gold");
```

| Call | Answers |
| --- | --- |
| `mb.generate.text(prompt, { max })` | `{ text }`. `max` is the longest answer in characters; the default is 1,200. It takes a few seconds |
| `mb.generate.image(prompt, { size })` | `{ url, sha }`. `size` is `"square"` (the default), `"wide"` or `"tall"`. It takes from 10 to 30 seconds |

- **Your page writes the prompt.** Put the viewer's words in it, and add your
  own words around them: the style, the framing, what the answer is for.
- **`url` is on your page's own address.** Show it in an `<img>`, or draw it to
  a canvas. Do not copy the file into your page.
- **`sha` names the picture.** Keep it if the viewer may want to keep the
  picture (see below).

## Every refusal is a value

A call never throws for a refusal. It answers `{ refused }` with one of these
reasons. Handle each one in your page's own voice, inside your page's own
design:

| `refused` | What happened | What your page does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sign_in` | the viewer is not signed in | say that making one needs a sign-in. We show the sign-in over your page |
| `allowance` | the viewer's own allowance is used up | say so. We show the plans over your page |
| `too_fast` | too many calls from this viewer on this page, in a minute or in a day | say they can make more later. Do not retry in a loop |
| `not_allowed` | the words were refused before anything was made | ask for other words. Do not repeat the refused words back |
| `unavailable` | the service did not answer | let them try again |

```js
const answer = await mb.generate.image(prompt);
if (answer.refused) return showRefusal(answer.refused); // your words, your design
show(answer.url);
```

## Show progress

A picture takes seconds, not milliseconds. From the moment the viewer asks:

- show at once that the request is in progress, in your page's own style;
- disable the button that asked, so one wait is not two calls;
- keep the page alive and usable while it waits.

## Keep a picture

A generated picture is a file your page received. When the viewer wants to keep
it, it becomes an item in their own inventory, and any page with an `image`
slot can show it (see `references/inventory.md`):

```js
const item = await mb.items.keep(sha, "image", { name: "Teal morpho" });
// item.files.png.url, item.files.icon.url, item.image.width, item.image.height
```

- `name` is from 1 to 60 characters. Use the viewer's own words for it.
- A viewer can keep only a picture they made themselves.
- Keeping the same picture again answers the same item.
- `keep` rejects with the reason `ACCOUNT_REQUIRED` when the viewer is not
  signed in. It follows the rules of the other `mb.items` calls, not the
  refusal values above.
